questions.text: For three weeks at the beginning of the semester students with fewer than the maximum number of units can add additional courses.
segments: at the beginning of the semester
with fewer than the maximum number of units
questions.explanation: Benar. Subject 'students', verb sejati 'can add'. Dua frasa depan di awal dan 'with fewer than ...' hanya penerang.
hints: Ada berapa klausa di kalimat ini?
Coret frasa depan dulu, lalu cari bagian yang membawa tense. Apa subjectnya?
Kalimat sudah benar: satu subject 'students' dan satu verb 'can add'. 'with fewer than ...' hanya penerang.

xray.marked: P{For three weeks} P{at the beginning of the semester} S{students} P{with fewer than the maximum number of units} V{can add} additional courses.

questions.text: On her lunch hour went to a nearby department store to purchase a wedding gift.

answer.fix: On her lunch hour she went to a nearby department store to purchase a wedding gift.

questions.explanation: Subject hilang. 'On her lunch hour' frasa depan, bukan subject. Tambahkan 'she' sebelum 'went'.
hints: Siapa yang melakukan 'went'? Ada ke mana subjectnya?
Coret 'On her lunch hour' dan 'to a nearby ...'. Masih ada kata benda atau pronoun sebelum 'went'?
Subject hilang. Tambahkan 'she' sebelum 'went'.

xray.marked: P{On her lunch hour} V{went} P{to a nearby department store} M{to purchase a wedding gift}.
xray.fixedMarked: P{On her lunch hour} S{she} V{went} P{to a nearby department store} M{to purchase a wedding gift}.

questions.text: The fir trees were grown for the holiday season were harvested in November.
questions.explanation: Satu subject, dua verb sejati tanpa connector. Jadikan 'grown' penerang (buang 'were') atau tambah 'that' sebelum 'were grown'.
hints: Ada berapa klausa? Ada connector?
Cari bagian yang membawa tense. Ada berapa?
'were grown' dan 'were harvested' sama-sama verb sejati, subject cuma satu. Buang 'were' pada bagian kedua.

xray.marked: S{The fir trees} V{were grown} P{for the holiday season} V{were harvested} P{in November}.
xray.fixedMarked: S{The fir trees} M{grown for the holiday season} V{were harvested} P{in November}.

questions.text: In the grove the overripe oranges were falling on the ground.
questions.explanation: Benar. 'were falling' = be + -ing, jadi verb sejati. Subject 'the overripe oranges'.
hints: Coret frasa depan 'In the grove' dan 'on the ground'.
Cek 'falling': ada be sebelumnya?
Benar. 'were' mendampingi 'falling', jadi 'were falling' verb sejati.

xray.marked: P{In the grove} S{the overripe oranges} V{were falling} P{on the ground}.

questions.text: The papers being delivered at 4:00 will contain the announcement of the president's resignation.
segments: the announcement of the president's resignation
questions.explanation: Benar. 'being delivered' tidak membawa tense (tidak ada be yang memegang tense), jadi hanya penerang. Verb sejati: 'will contain'.
hints: Hati-hati 'being delivered': ada be yang membawa tense?
'being' sendiri tidak membawa tense. Cari verb yang membawa tense setelah penerang itu.
Benar. 'being delivered at 4:00' penerang, verb sejati 'will contain'.

xray.marked: S{The papers} M{being delivered at 4:00} V{will contain} the announcement P{of the president's resignation}.

questions.text: A specialty shop with various blends from around the world in the shopping mall.

answer.fix: A specialty shop with various blends from around the world is in the shopping mall.

questions.explanation: Verb hilang. Setelah semua frasa depan dicoret, hanya ada subject. Tambahkan 'is' sebelum 'in the shopping mall'.
hints: Coret semua frasa depan: with..., from..., in....
Setelah dicoret, ada kata yang membawa tense?
Verb hilang. Tambahkan 'is' sebelum 'in the shopping mall'.

xray.marked: S{A specialty shop} P{with various blends} P{from around the world} P{in the shopping mall}.
xray.fixedMarked: S{A specialty shop} P{with various blends} P{from around the world} V{is} P{in the shopping mall}.

questions.text: The portraits exhibited in the Houston Museum last month are now on display in Dallas.
segments: exhibited in the Houston Museum last month
questions.explanation: Benar. 'exhibited ...' tanpa be/have adalah penerang untuk 'portraits'. Verb sejati: 'are'.
hints: Cek 'exhibited': ada be atau have sebelumnya?
Tanpa be/have, 'exhibited ...' berfungsi sebagai apa?
Benar. 'exhibited in the Houston Museum last month' penerang, verb sejati 'are'.

xray.marked: S{The portraits} M{exhibited in the Houston Museum last month} V{are} now P{on display} P{in Dallas}.

questions.text: With a sudden jerk of his hand threw the ball across the field to one of the other players.
segments: With a sudden jerk of his hand
to one of the other players

answer.fix: With a sudden jerk of his hand he threw the ball across the field to one of the other players.

questions.explanation: Subject hilang. 'With a sudden jerk of his hand' frasa depan, dan 'hand' adalah object of preposition, bukan subject. Tambahkan 'he'.
hints: 'hand' di awal itu subject atau bagian frasa depan?
Coret 'With a sudden jerk of his hand'. Siapa yang 'threw'?
Subject hilang. Tambahkan 'he' sebelum 'threw'.

xray.marked: P{With a sudden jerk of his hand} V{threw} the ball P{across the field} P{to one of the other players}.
xray.fixedMarked: P{With a sudden jerk of his hand} S{he} V{threw} the ball P{across the field} P{to one of the other players}.

questions.text: Construction of the housing development it will be underway by the first of the month.
segments: underway by the first of the month
questions.explanation: Subject berlebih. 'Construction' sudah jadi subject; 'it' memunculkan subject kedua untuk verb yang sama. Hapus 'it'.
hints: Hitung berapa subject dan berapa verb sejati.
'Construction' dan 'it' sama-sama kandidat subject. Verb sejatinya berapa?
Subject berlebih. Hapus 'it'.

xray.marked: S{Construction} P{of the housing development} S{it} V{will be} underway P{by the first of the month}.
xray.fixedMarked: S{Construction} P{of the housing development} V{will be} underway P{by the first of the month}.

questions.text: Those applicants returning their completed forms at the earliest date have the highest priority.
segments: returning their completed forms at the earliest date
questions.explanation: Benar. 'returning ...' tanpa be adalah penerang. Subject 'those applicants', verb sejati 'have'.
hints: Cek 'returning': ada be sebelumnya?
'returning ... date' tanpa be jadi penerang. Verb sejati mana yang tersisa?
Benar. Subject 'those applicants', penerang 'returning ...', verb 'have'.

xray.marked: S{Those applicants} M{returning their completed forms at the earliest date} V{have} the highest priority.
